data_fields.name: ease_per_tick
data_fields.donor_constant: quarter of the gap per call

data_fields.name: mouse_orbit_gain
data_fields.donor_constant: 0.25 degrees per pixel per call (0.5 x offset / 2)

best_idea: Keep the camera as data (ideal yaw, pitch and distance per zone) that player input writes and a per-frame ease chases toward ideal plus the character's facing, with a yaw clamp that keeps the camera out of the character's front and a zoom-in reset to directly behind.
decision_why: It is the only real third-person mechanism in this donor set and its ideal-plus-ease split with a rear-half clamp is what the world camera lacks; but it orbits to look at the character rather than framing over the shoulder, has no wall pull-in (its collision code is compiled out), and steps per frame, so Frankendom must add a shoulder offset, a real pull-in and dt-based easing before adopting it.
acceptance: In a zone with the default preset, a 90-degree turn of the character is trailed by the camera and settled to within 1 degree in under half a second, and releasing the look key leaves the camera where the player left it (client test).
